name: Charlie Connelly
mentions: Charlie Connelly, of the Hashknife outfit, has returned from the Hot Springs. He outfitted at Medora last week and started for the home ranch of the Hashknife Co., on Box Elder creek.
Charlie Conn[elly?], for a long time foreman of the Hashknife outfit, is now foreman for Clark & Plum, in the Panhandle, of Texas.
